artifact_type.description: Representation/schema identity only. This output is a distinct artifact produced by this node even when an input uses the same artifact_type; schema equality never authorizes an implicit passthrough.

verifier_ids.description: Checks applied to this specific output slot. Select only registered verifier IDs whose allowed artifact_types include the sibling artifact_type, and include the exact check for each requirement this output actually proves. Do not copy an upstream requirement's verifier onto a final publication bundle merely because the bundle depends on or summarizes that upstream evidence; keep that requirement owned by the verifier-compatible producing node instead.

consumes.description: Artifact types available to the node as inputs. Each value resolves to the unique closest producer in the dependency ancestry (or a controller input). A later same-typed transform shadows its earlier upstream state; incomparable closest producers are ambiguous. A consumed type is not satisfied by this node's own same-typed output and does not authorize aliasing.

produces.description: Table-like output slots to fill. Every row is a new node-produced artifact with its own materialization and verification contract, even when artifact_type matches a consumed input.

requirement_ids.description: Requirements this node itself proves through at least one produced output. Bind a requirement here only when a produced artifact can carry that requirement's exact registered check and its artifact_type is allowed by that check. Do not duplicate an upstream evidence, classification, or claim-verdict requirement on a downstream publication/delivery node merely because the final bundle reports or depends on the result; dependency carries the evidence while ownership remains on the verifier-compatible producer.
